heroTitle: Enterprise ERP Settings, Security & ETA Sync

visionDesc: Your corporate financials and operations require institutional-grade safeguarding. USoft is engineered with military-grade encryption, detailed activity logging, and failover resilience.

features.title: Certified Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) Integration
features.desc: Native integration with Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) SDK for electronic signatures, seals, and instant live invoice/receipt dispatch.

features.title: Granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
features.desc: Define granular permissions per role (create, edit, post, void, print) with branch-level and warehouse-level access boundaries.

features.title: Comprehensive Audit Trail & User Activity Logs
features.desc: Tamper-proof audit logs recording every creation, modification, and cancellation with timestamp, user ID, and IP tracking.

features.title: Multi-Company, Multi-Branch & Multi-Currency
features.desc: Manage multiple legal entities, branch locations, and international currencies in a single consolidated database.

features.title: Automated Cloud Backups & 256-Bit Data Encryption
features.desc: Scheduled automated cloud backups with AES 256-bit encryption ensuring instant disaster recovery and business continuity.

features.title: Open REST APIs & Third-Party Integration
features.desc: Secure REST APIs connecting USoft ERP seamlessly with e-commerce portals, CRM systems, payment gateways, and logistics apps.
